name: Science and Humanities
description: The Department of Science and Humanities serves as the bedrock of our engineering institution, fostering the intellectual and analytical foundation upon which all future engineers are built. The department is a vibrant, multidisciplinary hub comprised of dedicated faculty from the core scientific disciplines including Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry alongside the essential humanities such as English and Tamil. The primary mission is to transcend traditional theoretical instruction, creating a dynamic learning environment where fundamental scientific principles are rigorously taught and seamlessly connected to practical engineering applications. In addition, students are motivated and groomed to enhance their critical thinking skills, problem-solving aptitude and scientific temperament necessary to not only excel in their core engineering curriculum but also to innovate and adapt in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

Beyond the technical acumen, it is believed that the most impactful engineers are those who possess a profound understanding of the human context in which technology operates. The department is pivotal in nurturing the whole engineer, emphasizing the development of essential professional skills like effective communication, ethical reasoning, and collaborative teamwork. Through courses in the Humanities and Social Sciences the students are encouraged to think broadly, consider diverse perspectives and understand the societal and global implications of their work. We strive to instill a sense of social responsibility and a lifelong love for learning, ensuring our graduates are not just proficient technologists, but also thoughtful leaders and global citizens ready to shape a better future.
vision: To be a premier center of academic excellence that nurtures scientifically adept, analytically proficient, and ethically grounded engineers, who are empowered to drive innovation and address complex global challenges with a profound understanding of the human and social dimensions of technology.
mission: To Build a Strong Foundational Core: To deliver rigorous and application-oriented education in Basic Sciences (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry) and Humanities (English), equipping students with the critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills essential for mastering advanced engineering disciplines.

To Develop Holistic Professionals: To foster effective communication, collaborative teamwork, ethical reasoning, and leadership qualities through a dynamic curriculum that integrates Humanities and Social Sciences with technical education.

To Bridge Theory with Practice: To promote an interdisciplinary approach by encouraging research, project-based learning, and industrial collaborations that demonstrate the practical relevance of Science and Humanities in real-world engineering contexts.

To Cultivate Lifelong Learners: To instill a spirit of intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and social responsibility, inspiring students to become empathetic leaders and conscientious global citizens who contribute meaningfully to society and sustainable development.
p1: Greetings and a warm welcome to the Department of Science and Humanities at Anna University Regional Campus Coimbatore!
p2: As the foundational pillar of engineering education, the department is privileged to shape the intellectual and ethical development of every student who walks through our doors. The Department of Science and Humanities is a vibrant multidisciplinary hub comprising expert faculty from Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, English and Tamil all united by a shared commitment to academic excellence. The primary mission is to build a strong foundation in fundamental Sciences while simultaneously nurturing essential communication skills, critical thinking and ethical values. We believe the first year of engineering is not merely a transition but a transformative journey where young minds develop the mindset, analytical abilities and motivation to become future innovators and responsible citizens.
p3: At our department, we strive to create a dynamic learning environment that seamlessly bridges theoretical knowledge with practical application. Our well-equipped laboratories, includes Physics, Chemistry and Language Labs are designed to promote experiential learning and research orientation. The students are encouraged to explore, experiment and evolve, fostering a spirit of intellectual curiosity and a lifelong passion for learning. Through an integrated approach that emphasizes both academic rigor and personal growth, it is aimed to instill professional integrity, social responsibility, and a global perspective in our students. We invite you to make the most of the opportunities for learning and personal development that our department provides, and look forward to partnering with you on this exciting academic journey.

hod_desk.name: Dr. S. N. Mahalakshmi
hod_desk.profile: Dr S N Mahalakshmi, a distinguished scholar, boasts an illustrious academic journey marked by an unwavering commitment to English language pedagogy and scholarly exploration. With 23 years of dedication to English language teaching and profound research endeavors, she has made significant contributions to the field. Her scholarly footprint is evident through 27 publications in esteemed international and national journals. She has graced several platforms, such as 18 international and national conferences, with captivating presentations that illuminate the forefront of linguistic inquiry. An author of 12 seminal textbooks and workbooks tailored to the rigorous standards of technical English pertaining to the Anna University syllabus, her publications serve as guiding beacons, nurturing the linguistic prowess of countless students. Notably, seven of her scholars have been awarded PhD under her guidance, and currently, 2 research scholars are pursuing part-time PhD in English Language Teaching and Literature. As the Head of the Department of Science and Humanities at Anna University Regional Campus, Coimbatore, she orchestrates academic excellence with finesse, shaping the intellects of future generations along with her erudite members of faculty.

assistant_professors.name: Dr. S. Marshal Anthoni
assistant_professors.profile: Dr Marshal Anthoni S, an accomplished scholar in Systems and Control Theory, hails from P Puliampatti, Erode district. A proud alumnus of Gobi Arts and Science College, Gobichettipalayam, he received his B Sc, M Sc degrees in Mathematics, and his M Phil, and PhD degrees from Bharathiar University, Coimbatore. He has held teaching positions in various prestigious institutions and was a BK21 Post-Doctoral Fellow at Yonsei University, Seoul, South Korea. Since 2008, he has been a faculty member at Anna University Regional Campus, Coimbatore, where he currently serves as an Associate Professor. With over 90 research papers published in reputed Science Citation Indexed journals, his research contributions are widely recognized. Dr Marshal has also served as a program committee member and reviewer for various international journals and conferences. His academic pursuits have taken him to Japan, Spain, Brazil, Canada, Switzerland, China, South Korea, Nepal, and Oman.

facility.name: CHEMISTRY LABORATORY
description: The Chemistry Laboratory at Anna University Regional Campus, Coimbatore, is equipped with sophisticated laboratory infrastructure and advanced research facilities that support high-quality research, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaborations in emerging areas of science and technology.

The laboratory supports practical learning in core areas of chemistry such as physical chemistry, organic reactions, inorganic analysis, water technology, electrochemistry, and material characterization. Through a series of structured experiments, students learn how to operate laboratory glassware and instruments, prepare accurate chemical solutions, perform titrations, measure reaction parameters, and analyze experimental outcomes. This practical experience helps students build confidence in handling chemicals safely and connecting theoretical concepts to real chemical processes. Moreover, Practical sessions encourage students to adopt a systematic, safety-oriented, and scientific approach to problem-solving. While conducting experiments, students learn to adhere strictly to safety protocols, follow step-by-step procedures, compare experimental observations with expected chemical behavior, and evaluate potential sources of experimental error. These activities develop essential skills such as keen observation, precise measurement, logical deduction, data interpretation, and analytical reasoning.

At Anna University Regional Campus, Coimbatore, the Chemistry Laboratory serves not merely as a venue for conducting experiments, but as an engaging environment that fosters scientific curiosity, analytical rigor, safety awareness, and technical innovation. It helps students build a strong chemical foundation, preparing them to apply their knowledge effectively across various engineering disciplines and future professional endeavors.

facility.name: PHYSICS LABORATORY
description: The Physics Laboratory at Anna University Regional Campus, Coimbatore, is an important learning space where students experience the practical side of the concepts they learn in the classroom. Physics is not only about understanding theories and equations; it is also about observing how these principles work in real situations. The laboratory provides students with opportunities to explore these concepts through experiments, measurements, observations, and analysis.

The laboratory supports practical learning in fundamental areas of physics such as mechanics, properties of matter, heat and thermodynamics, optics, electricity, magnetism, and other related topics. Through a range of experiments, students learn how to use laboratory instruments, make accurate measurements, record observations, analyse experimental results, and understand the possible sources of error. This hands-on experience helps students develop confidence in handling scientific equipment and applying theoretical knowledge to practical situations.

Practical sessions also encourage students to think independently and approach problems scientifically. While conducting an experiment, students learn to follow systematic procedures, compare experimental results with theoretical values, identify variations, and draw meaningful conclusions. These activities help strengthen important skills such as observation, logical thinking, problem-solving, data interpretation, and scientific reasoning.

The Physics Laboratory plays a significant role in connecting classroom learning with real-world applications. It enables students to understand that the principles of physics form the foundation of many technologies and engineering applications used in everyday life. By combining theoretical knowledge with practical experience, the laboratory contributes to the overall academic and technical development of students.

At Anna University Regional Campus, Coimbatore, the Physics Laboratory therefore serves not merely as a place for conducting experiments, but as an environment that encourages curiosity, careful observation, experimentation, and scientific thinking. It helps students build a strong foundation in physics and prepares them to apply their knowledge effectively in their engineering studies and future professional endeavours.
